semantics: SAMPLE of named 8x8 graphs, sizes with the 16 stars plus the 12 free encoder wires as inputs (same model as star_4_enc.json). "lower" is proved: max of "lower_sat" (every smaller number of gates refuted by SAT in the normal-form model) and "lower_subcube" (largest exact 4x4 encoder size of a restriction obtained by fixing one row-index bit and one column-index bit). "size" is the smallest circuit found (checked with bin/cktcheck); "exact" iff size == lower. Labelled graphs; no symmetry reduction.
rows_convention: bit v of rows[u] = A u v
